question: How is the "voice-recognition" Den Den Mushi next to Loki different from other Den Den Mushi?
answer: Yes. So. Loki's body is restrained, right? The reason he can answer the Den Den Mushi even though he can't use his hands is because the Den Den Mushi can understand a little bit of human language and can connect the call. It can also be used to make calls, like saying "Hey, Siri!!" Ah!! It's time!! See you in the next volume~~~~!!
